headline: Land dispute: Salman Muqtadir’s studio vandalised in Dhaka
summary: The content creator claims the attack was linked to extortion demands, while police say it stemmed from a land dispute involving the building owner.
details: Content creator Salman Muqtadir’s studio in the ECB Chattar area of Dhaka was vandalised by miscreants around midnight on Saturday.
In a video shared on Facebook, Salman showed extensive damage to the studio, including destroyed chairs, tables, televisions, and other equipment.
Salman alleged that the attack may have been linked to extortion demands targeting the property's landowner, and his studio was damaged as a result of the revenge attack.
However, police reported that the attack was triggered by a land dispute involving the building owner, and three suspects have been detained in connection with the incident.
Addressing Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed in his video, Salman stated that such incidents are 'normal in Bangladesh' and urged the authorities to take note.
Despite the suffering and the sight of his crying employees, Salman vowed to continue his work and promised to return with something bigger.
caption:
A midnight attack leaves a content creator's studio in ruins. Was it extortion or a land dispute?

Content creator Salman Muqtadir’s studio in the ECB Chattar area of Dhaka was vandalised by miscreants around midnight on Saturday.

In a video shared on Facebook, Salman showed extensive damage to the studio, including destroyed chairs, tables, televisions, and other equipment.

Salman alleged that the attack may have been linked to extortion demands targeting the property's landowner, and his studio was damaged as a result of the revenge attack.

However, police reported that the attack was triggered by a land dispute involving the building owner, and three suspects have been detained in connection with the incident.

Addressing Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed in his video, Salman stated that such incidents are 'normal in Bangladesh' and urged the authorities to take note.

Despite the suffering and the sight of his crying employees, Salman vowed to continue his work and promised to return with something bigger.

Source: The Daily Star, Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV

headline: 17 killed, 15 wounded in shooting at South Africa tavern
summary: Gunmen armed with AK-47s and pistols targeted customers inside and outside a tavern in Wedela township, southwest of Johannesburg.
details: South African police have launched a manhunt after 17 people were killed and 15 others wounded in a shooting at a tavern in Wedela township, southwest of Johannesburg.
The victims included 13 males and 4 females, all of whom were declared dead at the scene by emergency medical services.
According to the South African Police Service, the suspects were reportedly armed with AK-47 rifles and pistols.
The attack occurred around 9:30 PM on Saturday in Gauteng province, where gunmen allegedly targeted customers drinking outside before moving inside to continue shooting.
Fifteen other victims with gunshot wounds were transported to medical facilities for treatment.
Police stated that no arrests have been made so far, and the motive for the shooting remains unknown.
caption:
17 dead and 15 wounded after gunmen with AK-47s storm a tavern in South Africa.

South African police have launched a manhunt after 17 people were killed and 15 others wounded in a shooting at a tavern in Wedela township, southwest of Johannesburg.

The victims included 13 males and 4 females, all of whom were declared dead at the scene by emergency medical services.

According to the South African Police Service, the suspects were reportedly armed with AK-47 rifles and pistols.

The attack occurred around 9:30 PM on Saturday in Gauteng province, where gunmen allegedly targeted customers drinking outside before moving inside to continue shooting.

Fifteen other victims with gunshot wounds were transported to medical facilities for treatment.

Police stated that no arrests have been made so far, and the motive for the shooting remains unknown.
